# neoshowcase Provider

Manages applications and related configuration in NeoShowcase.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11.0"

  required_providers {
    neoshowcase = {
      source = "comavius/neoshowcase"
    }
  }
}

provider "neoshowcase" {
  endpoint = "https://showcase.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) NeoShowcase Gateway base URL. May also be set with `NEOSHOWCASE_ENDPOINT` and defaults to `https://ns.trap.jp`.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Disables TLS certificate verification. This should only be used in development environments.
